title: In a Little While We're Going Home

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Eb]Let us sing a song [Ab]that will [Eb]cheer us by [Fm]the [Eb]way,
In a little while we’re going [Bb]home;
For the [Bb7]night will end in the [Eb]everlasting day,
In a [Fm]little while we’re [Eb]go[Bb]ing [Eb]home.
In a [Bb7]little while, In a [Eb]little while,
We [Fm]shall [Eb]cross the [Bb7]bil[Eb]low’s [Bb]foam;
[Eb]We [Fm]shall [Eb]meet at last, [Fm]When the [Ab]stormy winds are past,
[F7]In a [Eb]little [Fm]while we’re [Eb]go[Bb7]ing [Eb]home.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Eb]In [Ab]a little [Eb]while, [Fm]In a [Eb]little while,
[Bb]We shall cross the billow's foam;
[Bb7]We shall meet at last, [Eb]When the stormy winds are past,
[Fm]In [Eb]a little [Bb]while we're [Eb]going home.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Eb]We will [Ab]do the [Eb]work that our [Fm]hands may [Eb]find to do,
[Bb]In a little while we're going home.
[Bb7]And the grace of God [Eb]will our daily strength renew,
[Fm]In [Eb]a little [Bb]while we're [Eb]going home.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Eb]We will [Ab]smooth the [Eb]path for [Fm]some weary, [Eb]wayworn feet,
[Bb]In a little while we're going home.
[Bb7]And may loving hearts [Eb]spread around an influence sweet!
[Fm]In [Eb]a little [Bb]while we're [Eb]going home.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Eb]There's [Ab]a rest [Eb]beyond, there's [Fm]relief from [Eb]every care,
[Bb]In a little while we're going home;
[Bb7]And no tears shall fall [Eb]in that city bright and fair,
[Fm]In [Eb]a little [Bb]while we're [Eb]going home.
